critical_code_review_comments: enrich_badges (server.py:152) correctly joins user_badges rows with the static BADGES dict via _BADGE_DEFS_BY_ID lookup, returns 7 enriched fields, has safe fallback to 'Badge Mystérieux' / 'Sparkles' icon. Good defensive coding.
/api/stats/public wraps each sub-counter (events, presence, signups, visits, stability) in its own try/except — service stays up even if a subsystem fails. Good for a dashboard endpoint.
AdminContextMenu uses outside-click + Escape to close, has setTimeout(0) to skip the triggering click — proper UX.
Composer integration confirmed: POST /api/posts returns 200 and the new post is immediately visible in the feed (good optimistic refresh).
NexusOverlay.js at 1202 lines breaches the 700-line module guideline — extract AdminContextMenu into its own file.
